is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae, An. coluzzii, and An. arabiensis) in Burkina Faso.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotypes for Vgsc L995F (L1014F), Vgsc L995S (L1014S), and Ace-1 G280S (G119S).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Tables 2 and 3 provide detailed genotype counts (e.g., 119G/119G, 119G/119S, 119S/119S) for each species at each of the 15 study sites.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from 15 field sites across Burkina Faso.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting new field data collected in 2012.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study provides data for 15 specific sites (e.g., Gaoua, Banfora, Sindou) in Burkina Faso.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study reports new field collections from 2012.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is included in the main text tables.

assessment.summary: This study surveyed 15 sites in Burkina Faso in 2012 to assess the distribution and frequency of kdr (L1014F and L1014S) and Ace-1 G119S mutations in Anopheles gambiae s.l. It reports the first identification of the Ace-1 G119S mutation in An. arabiensis in the country.
